facts.text: Morehead State University's Space Science Center houses a 21-meter space antenna system and offers bachelor's and master's degrees in space systems engineering.

sources.title: Space Science Center | Morehead State University | Kentucky
sources.quote: The Space Science Center is home to MSU's Program of Distinction, the Bachelor of Science in Space Systems Engineering and the Master of Science in Space Systems Engineering.

sources.title: Space Science Center | Morehead State University | Kentucky
sources.quote: It includes a control center for the 21-meter space antenna system on the ridge top above Nunn Hall
